meta.source_series: Hellmuth's Home Game (Poker Night in America), Ep.1-30
meta.method: All 28 PokerNews episode recaps read in full; equities via Monte Carlo (20k iters) on recap-stated hole cards/boards; pot odds estimated from recap bet sizes. All equity/odds values are estimates.
meta.selection_rule: Villain all-in (or bet covering hero = de facto all-in) -> hero faces pure call/fold; both hands known via RFID/recap. estimated_correct_call = hero equity vs villain's actual hand > required pot odds at decision point, independent of hero's actual choice. Margin <= 8pp -> borderline (excluded from main 20).
known_limits: No YouTube chapters / FEATURED HANDS timestamps on any episode (yt-dlp checked Ep10/19/29); chapter_ts uses recap section + in-episode hand order
Recap wording cannot distinguish physical chip-push vs verbal all-in; allin_type=unknown pending video check; known-verbal hands (Ep13, Ep6 dark) excluded from main list
Ep24 & Ep30 full-episode URLs absent from provided TSV; Ep24 hands anchored to official clip ZWxOh8NkikI
meta.trivial_rule: Trivial 判定口径（2026-08-21，Byron 裁定）：只用 hero 视角信息（自己底牌+赔率+行动线，不看对手底牌），若标准牌理答案共识度 >90%（超对/三条+ 面对中小 jam=必call；无对无听面对大 jam=必fold；KK 翻前=必call；所需赔率 <15%=必call），则判 trivial、无读人增量，不入主名单。
meta.revision_note: 2026-08-21：T7/T8/T9/T10/F7/F10 六手被判 trivial 淘汰（见 retired_trivial），从 29 篇 recap 全量重挖替补换入。villain 配额两处放宽到 4（Texas Mike、Dan Cates）：TRUE 侧高质量非 trivial 手（bluff-catch/大池/长考）几乎全部以 TM/Cates/3Coin 为对手，不放宽无法凑满 4 手非 trivial TRUE，且两人 Hendon 均可查。
